description: This file contains a UiAutomator test case for setting a two-minute alarm on an Android device. It automates navigating the clock app, setting an alarm, and verifying that the alarm goes off as expected.

classes.name: SetTwoMinuteAlarm
classes.description: Main test class extending UiAutomatorTestCase to automate setting and verifying a 2-minute alarm, along with helper class LauncherHelper.

classes.name: LauncherHelper
classes.description: Nested static class providing reusable UiSelector constants for locating launcher UI elements.

methods.name: testDemo
methods.description: Main test method that runs the sequence of UI interactions to set and verify the alarm.

methods.name: setAlarm
methods.description: Helper method to set an alarm for a specified number of minutes from now.

methods.name: clickByDescription
methods.description: Utility method to click a UI object based on its content description.

methods.name: clickByText
methods.description: Utility method to click a UI object based on its visible text.
